$description: Ledger theme: dark editorial finance. Serif display and figures, square corners, slower and quieter motion.

numeric.$description: Money and quantities: IBM Plex Sans tabular, lining figures. Source Serif 4 and Schibsted Grotesk both give punctuation the figure width under tnum, which spaces out every amount.

4xl.$description: Display: page and section headlines on marketing and docs surfaces.

5xl.$description: Display: the one headline of a landing page.

unit.$description: Base of the spacing scale: every Tailwind spacing step is a multiple of it.

touch.$description: Minimum height of a control or its hit area on touch screens (pointer: coarse). Never follows density.

loop.$description: One turn of a looping indicator such as a spinner.

count.$description: A figure counting to its new value, such as a total. The one long movement: it is the signature moment.

reveal.$description: Content arriving as a page scrolls into it. Longer than any control transition; never on a control.

stagger.$description: The base step between items revealed together. Callers vary it per item (never a uniform beat) and keep it between 30 and 80ms.

exit.$description: Leaves on a strong ease-out at the fast duration: most of the way gone at once, so the interface answers immediately. Never an ease-in.

settle.$description: Eases out evenly to a soft stop, so a counting figure settles without crawling through its last cents.

shift.$description: How far a popup travels as it enters. Zero under reduced motion.

tick.$description: How far an amount nudges in the direction of a change. Zero under reduced motion.

arrive.$description: How far a toast rises as it arrives. Zero under reduced motion.

reveal.$description: How far content rises as it is revealed on scroll. Zero under reduced motion.

from.$description: Scale a popup starts from as it enters. One under reduced motion.

press.$description: Scale of a pressed button. One under reduced motion.

dialog.$description: Scale a dialog grows from, centred, as it opens. One under reduced motion.

spring.$description: Spring physics for the motion add-on (stiffness, damping, mass). Damping ratio at or near 1: settles without overshoot, never bounces.

press.$description: A pressed button returning to rest.

overlay.$description: A dialog or a list opening. Closing never springs: it is a fast tween on the exit easing.
